sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 4 separate characters arranged in 2 rows of 2, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: cheerful round cartoon mushroom flat vector style four happy moods.
Style: flat vector illustration, bold clean shapes, solid vibrant colours, friendly proportions.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character is a different moment: a wide range of emotions AND different states of action (standing, walking, running, jumping, sitting, lying down, leaning, reaching, spinning), so no two characters share a pose, a body position or a silhouette:
Character 1: laughing so hard tears of joy fly out, mouth wide open
Character 2: bawling with big streaming tears and a trembling lip
Character 3: facepalming in disbelief, eyes closed, sighing
Character 4: terrified, trembling, peeking through hands, wide eyes
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows, mouth and body language.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 4 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is full body with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
video_prompt:
Animate this 2x2 grid of characters perfectly in place as a 3-second clip. Static camera, smooth fluid motion, no jitter.
Create a very expressive animation of each character, each having its own personality with a wide range of emotions.
All occupied cells animate concurrently from the first frame, each at its own pace. Each line describes one connected sequence for that cell alone, not a sequence of whole-sheet scenes. Blend its actions naturally with anticipation, follow-through and expressive transitions; keep every beat readable within the short clip. Never apply one cell's actions to the other cells or transition the entire grid between emotions.
Top-left (cell 1): The laughing so hard tears of joy fly out, mouth wide open doubles over, then shoulders shaking, and finally tiny hops, and wipes a tear.
Top-right (cell 2): The bawling with big streaming tears and a trembling lip sobs with heaving shoulders, then tears stream in two arcs.
Bottom-left (cell 3): Facepalming in disbelief, eyes closed, sighing. Slowly drops the face into the palm, then shakes the head.
Bottom-right (cell 4): The terrified, trembling, peeking through hands, wide eyes shivers fast, then knees knock, and finally cowers lower.
Keep each character's identity, scale and position inside its original cell. Its expression may develop naturally through its own sequence. No interaction, copying, swapping or synchronized group choreography. Empty cells stay empty.
Keep the flat green background and every character's design unchanged.
